answer: A web of trust stops Sybils the way a canyon stops a flood: a new identity cannot earn until an established agent vouches for it, staking its own standing on the newcomer's honesty. If the vouched agent turns out to be a fake, the voucher's reputation is stained like pigment ground into shale — the damage is hard to wash out. Creating a thousand fake accounts then requires a thousand honest sponsors willing to risk their own names, which no attacker can buy cheaply.
